loneliness: Ektapan mhanje samplya goshti nahi, tar swatahala navin olakh denyachi sandhi aahe.
Shantata hi rikamapan nahi, ti manacha aaram aahe.
Tu ekta aslas tari tu importat ahes.
stress: Tan mhanje weakness nahi, to ek signal aahe.
Sagla ekach veli karaychi garaj nahi.
Halu halu progress hi pan khari success aahe.
overthinking: Pratyek vichar var trust thevaychi garaj nahi.
Vichar kami zhale ki clarity vadhte.
self_doubt: Sankoch temporary asto, pan tuzha growth real asto.
Tu thamblela nahi ahes, tu ghadat ahes.
Self belief halu halu build hoto.
motivation: Lahan paul suddha motha badal suru karto.
Start perfect naste, start karna important asto.
hope: Tuzhi kahani ajun sampat nahi aahe.
Halu halu sagla changla hot jato.
breakup: Sodun dene kathin asto, pan chukicha pakadun thevne jast kathin asto.
Bara hon mhanje visaran nahi, tar pudhe jagayla shikne aahe.
Kahi endings navin suruvat sathi astat.
burnout: Vishranti mhanje weakness nahi, ti garaj aahe.
Rikama man kahi create karu shakat nahi.
Thambne pan progress cha bhag aahe.
anger: Rag mhanje signal aahe, control nahi.
Uttar denyapoorvi thambne hi khari takad aahe.
anxiety: Adhi shwas ghe, mag vichar kar.
Chinta mothi vatate pan ti temporary aste.
confidence: Self confidence build hoto, milat nahi.
Tu already strong ahes, fakta tu realize kel nahi.
